purpose: Teach: 小冊子/鉄骨/凝縮/収める/経済学部/新株/チャーター/リクルート

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業初期に自ら小冊子を配付された
lines.en: Dad, in those early days you'd hand out those little pamphlets yourself.
lines.style: Gentle, reflective. Eyes slightly distant. Soft opening on the name, settling into admiration. Pace unhurried—remembering rather than informing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは鉄骨建築を先取りされた
lines.en: Yes. He saw where steel-frame construction was heading before anyone else did.
lines.style: Measured, respectful. Weight on the word 'saw'—genuine acknowledgment of foresight. Quiet conviction. The tone of a son speaking of his father's clarity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社訓を凝縮した一言、覚えてるか?
lines.en: Dad, do you remember that one line he used to say? The one about the company's whole philosophy?
lines.style: Softer now, searching. A slight pause before the question—reaching back into memory. Gentle curiosity, not testing. The warmth of someone who loved to hear his stories.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは赤字を確実に収める力をお持ちでした
lines.en: Yes. He had this gift for turning losses into strength—for making sure the numbers always balanced, no matter what.
lines.style: Thoughtful, specific. Not rushing to explain. Each phrase carefully placed. A hint of wonder underneath—the son still learning what his father could do.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、経済学部の若手を集めて研究会を開かれた
lines.en: Dad, he brought together all those young economists, didn't he? Held seminars at the house.
lines.style: Warm recollection. Slight lift on the memory itself. Slow, savoring pace. The voice of someone grateful to have been around such energy.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは新株発行の決断もされた
lines.en: Yes. And he made the call to issue new stock—a big decision at the time.
lines.style: Even, assured. A subtle emphasis on 'made the call'—respect for decisive leadership. Calm weight to it. The clarity of someone who understands what that decision meant.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、長距離のチャーター便で世界を回られた
lines.en: Dad, he chartered those long-haul flights and traveled the world, remember?
lines.style: Eyes bright with the memory. Slight wonder in the delivery. Gentle, almost marveling—the image of his father as a world-explorer still vivid.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはリクルート時代から才能を見抜かれた
lines.en: Yes. He had an eye for talent from his Recruit days on. He could always see what someone could become.
lines.style: Warm, final. A knowing quality—the son recognizing his father's gift for people. Slow, settling conclusion. Respectful but intimate.
